chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 77: The Bashe – A Glimpse of Ultimate Horror
chapter_meta_description: Yuan Er summons a cosmic horror called Bashe, leaving Li Huowang to discover the horrifying Thousand Greats Record, a manual for trading pain and flesh for power.
og_description: A glimpse into the abyss. Li Huowang confronts an entity beyond comprehension and uncovers the source of a new, terrible power.
twitter_title: The Thousand Greats Record has been found.
twitter_description: Li Huowang discovers the cult of suffering and an entity called Bashe. The horror is now personal.
